changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 5 item 10: split config/load.ts out of config/config.ts and deleted config/config-helpers.ts. Moved loadOrInitConfig, loadConfig, readConfigFile, resolveConfig, assertNoLegacyTomlOnly, the private providerRegistryFor, and the loader-only agentProviderRefs/channelProviderRefs/providerRefsFrom to load.ts; config.ts keeps the config data model, parse/validate (mergeWithDefaults, now exported for load.ts to call), stringifyConfig, redactConfigForDisplay, dispatcherAgent, the path builders, assertConfigFileMode, defaultWorkspaceEnabled, and the folded-in resolveConfigProvider/asChannelProvider/readOptionalBoolean/expandHome (expandHome's re-export shim is gone; it is defined directly in config.ts now). redactConfigSecrets (a bare alias of dreamux-utils's redactSecretKeyValues) is deleted; its one caller uses redactSecretKeyValues directly. Every moved function keeps its exact external behavior, signature, and return shape; this is a code-location move only.
